about: The ten moments on the timeline. For each: the airport report it shows (time, Dubai time, must match a report in april-2024.json), why it was chosen, the place in Dubai the camera flies to and the camera view there (lon, lat in degrees; height in metres; heading and pitch in degrees), and the news report shown in the panel. Moments, places and views were chosen by hand (interpretive). The news texts are placeholders until the real ones are added: each needs a headline, a short text, the source (publication, date, link) and, if there is one, a photo with its credit and licence. Put photos in data/photos/ (under 1 MB each, and only ones you may publish) and give the path, e.g. "data/photos/01.jpg".
